name: duopore-public-reorder-quantity-worksheet
description: Work out when stock may run low and how many whole packs to reorder.

interface.longDescription: Work out when stock may run low and how many whole packs to reorder. Enter daily demand, stock on hand, incoming units, delivery days and spare stock you want to keep. See the reorder point and a pack-sized order amount. The plan assumes steady demand and treats incoming stock as ready to use. It does not place an order.
defaultPrompt: How many packs should I reorder using these stock figures?
Work out my reorder point from demand and delivery time.

positive.prompt: Use Reorder Quantity Worksheet with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"items":[{"sku":"001","dailyDemand":2,"leadDays":5,"coverDays":10,"safetyUnits":3,"onHand":10,"inbound":0,"packSize":6}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 1 items meet the reorder trigger.","rows":[{"sku":"001","inventoryPosition":10,"reorderPoint":13,"targetStock":33,"reorderNow":true,"suggestedOrderUnits":24}],"warnings":["Steady-demand scenario; ignores variability, expiry and inbound arrival timing."]}
